entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent context database organizes information using a viking:// URI virtual filesystem and a three-tier loading system. It achieves significant token reduction and task-completion gains by extracting user preferences and agent experiences into long-term memory.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: A self-hosted knowledge graph engine designed to give AI agents persistent long-term memory across sessions. It builds these graphs from text, code, and session data while supporting storage, retrieval, and session distillation.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph to extract typed entity relationships. It provides synthesized answers with citations and explicit gap analysis while supporting multi-user institutional memory with scoped access.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that supports sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and offers connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system focused on retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends through SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: The upstream library for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper, implemented as a FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs. It enables stateful agents by extracting conclusions from conversation history to provide reasoning-first memory.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance across 20 LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that operates locally using a single SQLite database file. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports the Model Context Protocol for tools like Cursor.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage vector search and structured facts. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and auto-curated wikis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that helps agents retain lessons and artifacts through iterative task execution. It stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated promotion data directly in the filesystem.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A plugin for Hermes Agent that provides lossless context management through a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store. It ensures no messages are lost and includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep for detailed recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from 25 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over months of past data. It processes up to 5 GB of history while automatically redacting keys and tokens during the indexing phase.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible provider, ensuring data persistence across different agent sessions.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process to provide portable state across multiple agent clients. It achieves 97.6% average accuracy in LongMemEval benchmarks and supports real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to ensure local ownership of plain-text memory files. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25 and embeddings to serve MCP tools like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks, utilizing a hybrid retrieval system of vector search and BM25.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema and FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows via WSL2.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse and reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin offers explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recalled memory and includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments and features contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It runs local embedding models for hybrid semantic search without requiring telemetry or external databases.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to manage agent state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma. It is designed to provide a purpose-built evidence packet to the agent for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server that utilizes GGUF models for local-first vector search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files before the context window opens, resulting in 94% fewer prompt tokens. It provides local-first persistence and session history tracking through MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider implements reflective memory using edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia via OCR, utilizing a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity, decisions, and workflows for coding agents using plain Markdown files. It features a source-neutral migration workflow for documents and chats, supporting Claude Code, Codex, and other compatible agents.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories through 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to manage named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting real, immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log of all operations. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to settle payments directly to wallets across 37 chains, including EVM and Solana, with 0% fees. It allows for local transaction verification against a user's own RPC for secure, self-paying agent workflows.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing to connect agents with skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It features tools for knowledge retrieval and neighbor traversal, automatically generating routing notes via model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider ensures durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin offers self-organizing long-term memory with configurable query expansion and result reranking. It provides specific tools for agents to manually store memories or perform targeted searches.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin enables private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A functionality.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It provides hybrid retrieval options including HNSW ANN, sparse search, and FM-index exact-text recall.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This suite offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also includes automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within agent memory using a git-backed directory for versioned markdown storage. It utilizes five slash commands for capture and recall while generating evidence-cited diffs for manual review, ensuring memory hygiene without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology for autonomous task execution. It enhances agent reliability by enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles through plugins for coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes to generate and preview web, mobile, and desktop prototypes within sandboxed iframes. It supports 26 local CLI executables and allows for project exports in formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, compatible with over 26 AI platforms. It maps agent capabilities directly to industry frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the conversion of natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It further ensures architectural integrity by enforcing YAML and JSON rules through a Diagram-as-Test approach.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool provides a master router for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It integrates official protocol skills with a dedicated layer for verification and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It offers rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes specifically for Hermes and agentskills.io agents.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for the inspection of skills and detailed session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills designed for agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains persistent session states within a project's documentation directory to support Claude Code and Codex workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills distributed as plain markdown files for native use in Hermes Agent. The MIT-licensed repository provides ready-to-paste exports to extend the capabilities of various AI assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This tool grants Hermes the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It functions across multiple environments including OpenClaw and Cursor, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via specialized slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches agents to write their own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources using Pydantic AI. It features sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. It includes Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill weaves prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol for supervised teams. It utilizes SQLite and Git for local-first storage and provides prompt-first working methods through Markdown-based recipes.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integrations for CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams, and is installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project serves the Brazilian Hermes Agent community by providing installation guides and skills in Portuguese. All resources follow the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models via the BFL API. The project includes a router to direct requests to specialized video agents and supports polling, webhooks, and error handling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It manages skill lifecycles by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits for version-controlled exports.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io acts as a registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It features a Python client and CLI that support recursive dependency resolution and commerce via TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI that operates via a Rust-based CLI using four verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It supports model processing through OpenAI API and Codex access.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill facilitates autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for task recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The project is designed for resilience, offering graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Hermeshub serves as a community hub for browsing and installing skills, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution system uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling, habits, and study blocks. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes agent communication by rewriting and scoring prompts across multiple surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It supports 97 languages and claims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite while scoring quality across five dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard provides adversarial code review by employing three parallel subagents to hunt for bugs and edge cases. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three specialized agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It supports multiple programming languages and includes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, requiring evidence-based verification gates at every stage. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for managing persistent task states.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards to address real-world exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for README files using vhs or Playwright. It handles rendering, compression to under 8 MB, and markdown embedding.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language and validates them against runtime-specific profiles. It includes a monitor that checks official frontmatter specs weekly to detect and report drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework implements a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify skill coverage gaps. Updates are gated behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: A local-first, read-only observability dashboard providing 11 monitoring tabs for token costs, health, and error tracking. It ensures zero outbound telemetry and offers optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables searching over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands and integrates with clients such as Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL. They ensure file operations use environment-specific syntax and verify project-compatible interpreters.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This service certifies agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: A plugin for earning or hosting USDC bounties on the Base network via x402 without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties, buying context, and managing boards.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides 191 tools via a hosted MCP server for structured web data across 31 platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator that produces structured reports from global to street-level scales. It utilizes semantic memory to expand searches based on user interests.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: A collection of utility skills including a rule-based engine to remove Chinese AI writing patterns and a macOS-based OCR tool. It also features a local processor to transcribe Douyin links into Markdown and SRT.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered knowledge graph that indexes code symbols and callers to minimize token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically updates the index upon file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and provides a Terminal User Interface for data visualization. Users can create profiles and submit their usage statistics to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits across more than 35 AI coding tools. It synchronizes data across multiple devices and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with various agents and providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for application development. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project enables customization of the terminal UI through YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to personalize their CLI experience.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel that operates without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for RL training and inference using vLLM and GGUF.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, supporting providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and an undo function for recent agent actions.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks and chat platforms using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports environments including LangGraph, CrewAI, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations, local memories, and specific skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local custom instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs deterministic analysis of agent configurations and system prompts without requiring LLM or API calls. It identifies ambiguous tool descriptions and conflicting directives, supporting CI integration through SARIF output and baseline management.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transfers OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems via a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It features two-mode monitoring—passive analysis and active probing—to detect performance drift relative to local file changes without cloud dependencies.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project offers a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for external actions and exposes its functionality through dynamic slash commands.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word-activated interaction to Hermes Agent across 35 languages. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities using Piper and Kokoro without requiring accounts or API keys.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This plugin integrates MemOS memory storage with Hermes, supporting semantic search and multi-dimensional storage. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and a circuit breaker to handle potential MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a centralized interface for managing configurations across multiple tools, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It supports remote interaction via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram, and includes 21 professional assistants for specialized tasks such as document creation.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard provides unified configuration for 10 platforms, including WhatsApp and Slack, across various runtimes like Hermes and Claude Code. It features a visual workflow builder with human approval gates, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace integrates a Monaco-based file browser and PTY terminal with a skills manager and MCP catalog. It includes a Swarm Mode that utilizes role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for agent coordination.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, into a single collaborative workspace. It is available as a desktop app, Docker container, or native mobile client, and allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application features a specialized kernel with health check and update capabilities. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside chat and memory management tools.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium extension connects active browser context to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes via a side-panel. It includes a 'Bot Mode' for multi-agent switching and 'Hermes Assist' for site-aware drafting and tab management.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that connects directly to self-hosted hermes-webui servers without third-party relays. It enables mobile task management, real-time chat, and workspace file browsing.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It enables users to track agent growth and scheduled cron jobs while providing a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and real-time chat with tool call visualization. It includes an MCP server control plane and the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live API quota burn and estimated costs for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across agent histories without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically features an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It differentiates itself by including a kanban board for agentic work alongside management tools for skills and profiles.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA functions as a Telegram Mini App with dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and can spawn up to five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop GUI runs via portable Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or system dependencies. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supporting both local models via LM Studio and cloud models via OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes dedicated management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring-focused dashboard that provides real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories, offering read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace utilizes real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
